description: This file defines the AbbreviationsDictionary class, which manages abbreviation suggestions using an SQLite database and in-memory mappings. It provides methods for retrieving suggestions based on typed words, handling abbreviation and expansion logic, and managing internal data structures.

classes.name: AbbreviationsDictionary
classes.description: A dictionary class that manages abbreviations and their expansions, providing suggestions based on user input.

methods.name: AbbreviationsDictionary
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dictionary with context and locale.

methods.name: createStorage
methods.description: Creates a new SQLite connection for storing abbreviations.

methods.name: getMaxWordLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed word length for abbreviations.

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.description: Provides abbreviation suggestions based on the current typed word, considering capitalization.

methods.name: reportExplodedWords
methods.description: Reports all expansions associated with a given abbreviation to the callback.

methods.name: addWordFromStorageToMemory
methods.description: Adds a word and its frequency to the in-memory map of abbreviations and expansions.

methods.name: getAbbreviation
methods.description: Static method returning the abbreviation part of a word based on frequency.

methods.name: getExplodedSentence
methods.description: Static method returning the expansion part of a word based on frequency.
